messages:
sam_marketing: Quick sync: we need final timing + canonical docs link for the release flight deck. Aim to publish next Fri 15:00 PT. Can eng confirm rollout plan?

mira_engineering: Plan: 30m smoke -> 90m canary -> gradual ramp. Suggested canary start 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z. End conditions: rollback if 5xx >1% sustained 10m or median latency +25%.

tara_docs: Docs preview is live: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-27. Changelog bullets ready. Recommend merge before publish; will add one-line about the model pinning config.

alan_product: Merge docs if possible. Also note: Dedicated customers need CS-assisted rollout. Add that line to the post.

noah_sales: HubSpot form URL ready: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/release-march-27. Tag leads with "mar27-release" and "mar27-webinar". Please include UTM for benchmark traffic.

sam_marketing: Draft excerpt for social: "New release: faster cold starts, opt-in model pinning, smarter batching. See changelog + docs: <canonical docs link>. Join our webinar for demos." Need canonical docs URL and bench image by EOD.

mira_engineering: Canonical docs URL after merge will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-27. Perf will upload median-latency PNG to this thread by 18:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-03-27T01:30:00Z; canary 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-27T03:30:00Z; ramp 2026-03-27T04:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds set as above.

sam_marketing: Great. Final checklist: 1) docs canonical URL (tara), 2) canary endpoints + thresholds (mira), 3) HubSpot + tags (noah), 4) bench PNG (mira). If all green we'll lock publish for Fri 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert for any slips.

tara_docs: Will merge after final proof at 20:00 PT and post canonical link here.

mira_engineering: Bench PNG ETA 18:00 PT. All tests passing on staging.

sam_marketing: Thanks all — locking plan unless someone objects. :rocket:
